nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $\mathbb{R}^n$ denotes the real Euclidean space of dimension $n$: real vectors with coordinates indexed by $0, \dots, n-1$, with the Euclidean inner product and norm.
nodes.title: Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$

Then $g$ is a weak derivative $D^m f$ of $f$ when every smooth ($C^\infty$) compactly supported function $\varphi : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies
nodes.title: Weak derivative

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$ and a real number $\alpha$, a function $g : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ belongs to $C^{r,\alpha}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ when $g$ is $r$ times continuously differentiable, its iterated derivatives $D^j g$ for $j \le r$ are bounded on $\mathbb{R}^n$, and its $r$-th derivative is $\alpha$-Hölder: there is $C \ge 0$ with $\|D^r g(x) - D^r g(y)\| \le C \|x - y\|^{\alpha}$ for all…
nodes.title: Hölder space $C^{r,\alpha}(\mathbb{R}^n)$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $k$ and $p \in [0, \infty]$, a function $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ belongs to $W^{k,p}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ when $f$ is locally integrable and, for every multi-index $m = (m_0, \dots, m_{n-1})$ of natural numbers with $m_0 + \cdots + m_{n-1} \le k$, $f$ has a weak derivative $D^m f$ that lies in $L^p(\mathbb{R}^n)$. Local integrability and $L^p$ are with respect to Lebesgue measure.
nodes.title: Sobolev space $W^{k,p}(\mathbb{R}^n)$

nodes.summary: For a multi-index $m = (m_0, \dots, m_{n-1})$ of natural numbers and a function $\varphi : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$, the mixed partial derivative is $D^m \varphi = \partial_0^{m_0} \partial_1^{m_1} \cdots \partial_{n-1}^{m_{n-1}} \varphi$, where $\partial_i^{j}$ is the $j$-fold iterate of the partial derivative $\partial_i$; thus $\partial_{n-1}$ is applied first and $\partial_0$ last.
nodes.title: Mixed partial derivative

nodes.summary: For a coordinate index $i \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}$ and a function $\varphi : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$, the partial derivative $\partial_i \varphi$ is the function $\mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ sending $x$ to $D\varphi(x)(e_i)$, the Fréchet derivative of $\varphi$ at $x$ applied to the $i$-th standard basis vector $e_i$. At points where $\varphi$ is not differentiable its value is $0$.
nodes.title: Partial derivative

nodes.summary: Let $n, k, r$ be natural numbers and $\alpha, p$ real numbers with $n < p$, $0 < \alpha \le 1$ and $r + \alpha < k - n/p$. Then every function $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ in the Sobolev space $W^{k,p}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ is equal almost everywhere, for Lebesgue measure, to some function $g$ in the Hölder space $C^{r,\alpha}(\mathbb{R}^n)$.
nodes.title: Sobolev embedding theorem (Morrey regime)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
